paper.title: An Asymptotically Optimal Primal-Dual Incremental Algorithm for Contextual Linear Bandits

unmapped: finite context set X with i.i.d. contexts from distribution rho, rho(x) >= rho_min > 0
unique optimal arm in each context
parameter set Theta compact with ||theta||_2 <= B
settings.definition_quote: At each time step $t \in \mathbb{N}$, the learner observes a context $X_t\in\X$ drawn i.i.d.\ from a context distribution $\rho$, it pulls an arm $A_t\in\A$, and it receives a reward $Y_{t} = \phi(X_t,A_t)^\transp\theta^\star + \xi_t$ ... where $\xi \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^2)$ is a Gaussian noise.

symbols.v_star: value of the lower-bound optimization problem (P), v^*(theta^*)

extra_assumptions: Assumption 1 (bounded params/features, rho_min>0, unique optimal arm per context)
beta_{t-1}=c_{n,1/n}, gamma_t=c_{n,1/S_t^2}, z_k=z_0 e^k, p_k=z_k e^{2k}

source.label: thm:regret.bound
source.quote: If \algo is run with confidence values $\beta_{t-1} = c_{n,1/n}$ and $\gamma_t = c_{n,1/S_t^2}$, ... learning rates $\alpha_k^\lambda = \alpha_k^\omega = 1/\sqrt{p_k}$ and increasing sequences $z_k = z_0 e^k$ and $p_k = z_k e^{2k}$, for some $z_0 \geq 1$, then it is \textbf{asymptotically optimal} with the same constant as in the lower bound of Prop.~\ref{p:lower.bound}.

results.notes: Asymptotic optimality stated as matching the lower-bound constant; normalization of regret by log n inferred from Prop 1 and appendix limsup statement.

symbols.c_T: confidence radius c_{n,1/n} = O(log T + d log log T)
symbols.C_const: v_star B^2 L^2/sigma^2 + lin_{>=0}(L, B, z_0 (z_underline/z_0)^3, (z_bar/z_0)^2)

source.label: thm:regret.bound
source.quote: Furthermore, for any finite $n$ the regret of \algo is bounded as $\E_{\xi,\rho}^\pi [ R_n(\theta^\star) ] \leq v^\star(\theta^\star) \frac{c_{n,1/n}}{2\sigma^2} + C_{\log} (\log\log n)^{\frac{1}{2}}(\log n)^{\frac{3}{4}} + C_{\mathrm{const}}$

results.notes: Constants C_log, C_const only specified up to nonnegative linear functions of listed quantities.

bound.regime: any T; p_k = e^{rk}, r >= 1, z_k arbitrary

symbols.C_sqrt: lin_{>=0}(|X| + sqrt(d), B, L), |X| number of contexts

source.label: th:worst-case
source.quote: Let $z_k$ be arbitrary, $p_k = e^{rk}$ for some constant $r \geq 1$, and the other parameters be the same as in Thm.~\ref{thm:regret.bound}. Then, for any $n$ the regret of \algo is bounded as \E[R_n] \leq 12BL\pi^2C_{\lambda_{\max}} + \frac{2e^r(\lambda_{\max}^2 + \log|\A|)}{r}\sqrt{n} + C_{\mathrm{sqrt}} C_{\lambda_{\max}}\log (n) \sqrt{dn}

results.notes: Paper's B (param norm) mapped to S and L to L_feat; |A| mapped to K. Paper summarizes as O~((sqrt(d)+|X|)sqrt(dn) + log|A| sqrt(n)).

cited_results.setting_description: Contextual linear bandit with finite contexts/arms, Gaussian noise, uniformly good strategies (also attributed to combes2017minimal, ok2018exploration)
